content.short: BonusBlock is a Web3 engagement protocol and marketplace for projects seeking to grow their on-chain user base.
content.description: BonusBlock is an engagement protocol and marketplace built for Web3 projects. It tackles the complexities of on-chain user engagement by implementing a verifiable activity system that classifies each user's actions. This structured approach enables projects to broaden their on-chain user base while offering distinct engagement quality tiers, allowing tailored incentives, clearer analytics, and scalable growth across multiple supported networks.
